Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

It sounds like binding commitment, rather than a forecast alone, is what lets you allocate additional capacity. If you can secure our full requirement, we are ready to commit long-term and allow planning room through lead time. How can we turn that commitment into a dependable allocation that supports both your capacity planning and our supply continuity?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.38 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide.

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

The extended lead time of 56 days and the 36-month commitment provide the necessary planning security to allocate the requested 23,400 units. We can offer €31.70 per unit under these revised terms. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
